MACRO_ACTIONS §11's 'every motion special fails at gap 1' is CORRECTED: it holds for REPEATED-direction motions only -- blade_spark (down, back) fires at neutral gap 0 and 1 as well, because two DIFFERENT directions cannot merge into one hold. video._NOTE: Framebuffer + palette inside the one exposed region, for asset ripping (scripts/re/rip_mk2_cels.py). Offsets are FBNeo MemIndex() positions of DrvPalette/DrvVRAM within AllRam..RamEnd (src/burn/drv/midway/midtunit.cpp); layout verified live 2026-08-29 by reconstructing a paused frame and diffing it against app://screen (99.6% exact pixel agreement; colors must be expanded v<<3, NOT v*255/31, or agreement collapses to ~1%). A VRAM word is palette_bank<<8 | pixel; displayed color = palette[word & index_mask] (ScanlineRender :547). The blitter stamps DMA_PALETTE into the high byte (:469) and skips transparent pixels, so masking on the high byte isolates one sprite's opaque pixels. CAVEAT: the display ORIGIN (rowaddr/coladdr, ScanlineRender :531) is TMS34010 register state OUTSIDE this region and is not always (0,0) — measured (0,56) live — so a reader must search for it rather than assume it; rows_total is the addressable VRAM height, rows the visible height.

blade_swipe._min_frames_note: the back+HP CONJUNCTION must be down >= 2 consecutive frames; frames: 1 produces nothing (measured 1 fails / 2..12 fire). Do not lower `frames` below 2.

double_kick._frames_note: frames: 9 is not a hold length the game cares about -- it is what makes STEP_GAP = 2 land the SECOND press 11 frames after the first, inside the measured 11..16 onset window. The invariant is `onset_after` on the next step; this number is how today's executor satisfies it.
